newsitem.title: GERMANY: Schmidhuber-ECB must not compromise stability goal.
newsitem.headline: Schmidhuber-ECB must not compromise stability goal.

text.p: Bundesbank council member Peter Schmidhuber said on Wednesday that the coordination of economic policy in Europe after the start of currency union should not become a counterweight to the European Central Bank.

"The necessary coordination of economic policy cannot become a "counterweight" to the European Central Bank, but must be decided by an institution which acts as a partner to the ECB and is similarly dedicated to the stability of the currency," Schmidhuber said in the text of a speech.
He said the ECB is bound to uphold the stability of the euro after the start of European economic and monetary union in January 1999.
